g.title: None.None.Node.1
g.text: AWS serverless event-driven order platform in a VPC

g.title: None.None.Node.39
g.text: The customer posts an order to the HTTP API
API Gateway checks the customer's token against Cognito
API Gateway invokes the orders Lambda in a private subnet
The Lambda saves the order to DynamoDB through the gateway endpoint
It publishes an OrderPlaced event to EventBridge through the interface endpoint
The bus starts the Step Functions fulfilment workflow
The fulfilment Lambda charges the payment provider, the only traffic that leaves through NAT
A queued notification triggers the notifications Lambda, which alerts the customer through SNS
Firehose writes every event to the S3 event lake, catalogued by Glue and queried with Athena
